limitations: No complete A3 claim or ordinary native/state integration.

reproduction.scope: Exact-artifact reproduction with external pinned prerequisites and fresh explicit runtime owners. Historical prospective recipe prose is preserved; this report supplies the actual fresh closure.

state.scope: All 2606 captures, 144 traces, 360 points, 768 pages, zero hooks; all 167 remaining-chain helpers.
